# Typography

Typography should reduce reading effort, not become the subject of the resume.

## Defaults

- Body text: 11 pt
- Section headings: 12 pt bold
- Name: 21 pt bold
- Margins: 18 mm on all sides (approximately 0.7 inches)
- Body font: Arial, with Aptos, Calibri, Helvetica, or Liberation Sans as practical alternatives

## Why these are defaults, not laws

Readable size depends on font metrics, page size, export quality, and the reader's environment. The framework therefore uses a conservative middle range rather than claiming one exact size is universally best.

Avoid shrinking the body below a comfortable reading size to force content onto one page. Edit weak or repetitive content first. Experienced candidates may use two pages when the second page contains relevant evidence.

## Hierarchy

The template limits hierarchy to three clear levels:

1. Candidate name
2. Section headings
3. Entry headings and body text

Bold, spacing, and alignment carry the hierarchy. Color and decoration are unnecessary.
